titleByLocale.it: Venditore di cornici e protezione solare

descriptionByLocale.it:
Non vedo l'ora.
• Settimana di 39 ore
• Interruzioni flessibili
• 65 % dei contributi BVG versati
• 13. Salari mensili
• Parcheggio gratuito C'è sempre qualcosa da fare

descriptionByLocale.en:
You can look forward to it.
• 39-hour week
• Flexible breaks
• 65 % of the BVG contributions paid
• 13. Monthly wages

descriptionByLocale.en:
You can look forward to it.
• 39-hour week with flexible breaks
• Full-time or part-time selection between 40% and 100%
• BVG share (pension fund) of 65 % paid
• Fair minimum wage from CHF 4'400
• Generous maternity and paternity leave
• At least 5 weeks of vacation per year There is always something to do
• You are responsible for ensuring that we have the right goods, at the right time, in the right quantity.
• Your workplace is the sales area where you check the stocks and order the goods.
• You communicate with suppliers and ensure the internal flow of information.
• You analyze the quality of our warehouse goods with various statistics from our system.
• You support your team wherever there is something to do. Your foundation
• You have already gained experience with ordering goods in the retail trade.
• We can rely on your analytical way of thinking.
• Your work is reliable and careful.
• You have a high sense of responsibility and stay positive in stressful situations.
• You communicate promptly and clearly and enjoy working in a team. Area: Logistics / Supply Chain

• Du hast ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und bleibst in stressigen Situationen positiv.
• Du kommunizierst zeitnah sowie klar und arbeitest gerne im Team.
